title: August 2026
campaignIntro: This SEO campaign is focused on improving Shift Physiotherapy’s visibility for local physiotherapy searches and helping more patients find the practice online.
Each month, we monitor technical site health, keyword visibility, and on-page opportunities to strengthen search performance and support sustainable organic growth.
monthlyRecap: August reporting shows strong keyword momentum. Across 76 tracked keywords, the average position improved from 14.63 to 12.07 over the last 30 days, a gain of 2.56 positions.
The technical audit remains in excellent condition with a 99/100 on-page SEO score. The latest crawl found just two duplicate meta descriptions, giving us a focused next technical cleanup item.

recap: The August audit reports a 99/100 on-page SEO score, 652 estimated organic monthly visits, 271 organic keywords, and 180 backlinks.
The crawl reviewed 195 URLs and identified two pages with duplicate meta descriptions. We will review and resolve those descriptions as part of the next technical optimization cycle.

Of 76 tracked keywords, 32 moved up, 26 moved down, and 18 held steady during the reporting period. Visibility improved in the most valuable ranking groups, with 12 keywords in the top 3 and 23 in the top 10.
The average position improvement to 12.07 reflects steady upward momentum. We will continue monitoring the terms that declined while building on the gains across the current keyword set.
The August activity log will be added as completed work is finalized.

nextSteps: Resolve the two duplicate meta descriptions identified in the August technical audit and continue monitoring crawl health.
Build on the August ranking gains with ongoing on-page refinement, internal linking, and local content opportunities.
